The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has announced the Computer-Based Test Stage II (CBT-II) results for the Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) 10+2 Under Graduate posts. Candidates who appeared for the examination can check their results on the official regional RRB websites.

According to the notification issued under CEN 07/2025, the application window was open from 28 October 2025 to 04 December 2025, with fee payment concluding on 06 December 2025 and correction windows lasting until 12 December 2025. The CBT-II examination was conducted on 17 September 2026.

Recruitment Overview and Key Dates

  • Issuing Authority: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
  • Notification ID: CEN 07/2025
  • Posts: NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Posts
  • Application Start Date: 28 October 2025
  • Application Last Date: 04 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 06 December 2025
  • Correction Dates: 07 December 2025 – 12 December 2025
  • CBT-II Exam Date: 17 September 2026
  • CBT-II Result Status: Released / Available Now

Eligibility and Application Details

  • Educational Qualification: 10+2 Intermediate Exam from any recognized board in India, along with required skill criteria such as Computer Typing proficiency (English 30 WPM or Hindi 25 WPM) where applicable.
  • Age Limit / Cut-Off Date: Not specified in the primary announcement text (governed by standard RRB rules with applicable age relaxations).
  • Vacancies: Not specified in the immediate summary details (candidates should check zone-wise notifications).
  • Application Fees & Refund Policy: General and OBC candidates are eligible for a fee refund of Rs. 400/-, while other categories are eligible for a refund of Rs. 250/- credited to their bank accounts after appearing for the initial exam stages. Online payment modes included Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, and Mobile Wallets.

Selection Stages and Status

The recruitment process comprises computer-based testing stages (CBT-I and CBT-II), skill assessments where applicable, and subsequent document verification. The CBT-II result status is currently active, and admit cards, answer keys, and scorecards can be accessed via historical portal links.

How to Verify and Check Results

  • Visit the official website of your respective regional Railway Recruitment Board.
  • Navigate to the results section and select the link for "CEN (NTPC) Under Graduate Level Result 2026".
  • Log in using your credentials, such as Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth.
  • Download and print a copy of your result or scorecard for future reference.

Candidates are strongly advised to independently cross-verify all notifications, scorecards, and updates directly from official RRB regional portals.
